name: Malfegor
description: A demon whose invasion force attacked Bant.

timeline.summary: Asha sacrifices herself in battle with the demon Malfegor.
timeline.quote: Asha, the plane's protector, sacrificed herself in battle with the demon Malfegor .

citation.text: "Alara", section "The Sundering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Asha defeats Malfegor, banishing him to Grixis, and leaves a sigil that kept Bant safe.
timeline.quote: she simply banished him to the Shard of Grixis

citation.text: "Angel", section "Bant". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Archangel Asha, ruler of Bant, gives her life fighting the demon Malfegor; no angel assumes her title afterward.
timeline.quote: who gave her life fighting the demon Malfegor long ago

citation.text: "Bant", section "Angels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth helps Rafiq kill Malfegor, ending Bant's part in the Conflux war.
timeline.quote: she assisted Rafiq in killing Malfegor

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Alaran Paradise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eliza's kathari scout reports that the archdemon took the bait she gave it about a human hermitage and has left Unx.
timeline.quote: "The archdemon took the bait, haaak ."

citation.text: "Encounter at the Necropolis". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas orders his general Malfegor to assemble an army of necromancers and undead and destroy remaining human holdouts on Grixis.
timeline.quote: He bids Malfegor assemble an army of the most powerful necromancers and the most horrifying undead

citation.work: The First Days of the Conflux
citation.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Malfegor kills the archangel Asha in Bant and is exiled to Grixis.
timeline.quote: he killed an archangel named Asha but was exiled to Grixis

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Grixis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Mending, Nicol Bolas orders Malfegor to prepare an army against the other Shards.
timeline.quote: the elder dragon Nicol Bolas told Malfegor to prepare an army to attack the other Shards

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Grixis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Malfegor is killed in Bant by Elspeth Tirel and Rafiq.
timeline.quote: he attacked Bant, where he was killed by Elspeth Tirel and Rafiq

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Grixis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Grixis becomes part of the New Alara, demon cults rise, and after Malfegor dies chaos reigns among factions.
timeline.quote: After the death of the plane's de facto leader, Malfegor , chaos reigns

citation.text: "Grixis", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Malfegor kills Asha, ruler of Bant's angels, during the splitting of Alara, leaving the throne empty.
timeline.quote: since she died at the hands of Malfegor during the splitting of Alara

citation.text: "The Vorthos Awards: Conflux Edition". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Malfegor, a Grixis monster, remembers when he was the most fearsome being on young Alara and seeks only to restore his lost position.
timeline.quote: He remembers the old days, when he was the most fearsome being on a young Alara

citation.text: "Choices in the New Alara". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Malfegor rises over the battlefield, quickening both demons and angels, who see a chance to end their ancient war.
timeline.quote: The blood of the demons quickened as their master rose over the battlefield.

citation.text: Breath of Malfegor (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Malfegor captures Dack on Grixis hoping to steal his spark, but Dack escapes.
timeline.quote: Before Malfegor could attempt his plan, though, Dack escaped

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dack Fayden is confronted by the draconic demon Malfegor and senses it has met other Planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: The draconic demon loomed over Dack

citation.text: Breath of Malfegor (IDW Comics Inserts, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eliza lures Unx's demonic master out by betraying a hidden Hermitage, and takes the necropolis.
timeline.quote: She successfully launched an attack against the necropolis of Unx, claiming it for her own.

citation.text: "Eliza", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Malfegor slays the archangel Asha and is exiled to Grixis.
timeline.quote: he slew the archangel Asha

citation.text: "Malfegor", section "Before the Sundering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Grixis Malfegor kidnaps and tortures fledgling planeswalkers; his first success is Sifa Grent.
timeline.quote: His first success was Sifa Grent .

citation.text: "Malfegor", section "On Grixis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dack Fayden is imprisoned, escapes, and kills Malfegor's head jailer.
timeline.quote: After Dack killed Malfegor's head jailer, Malfegor tried to take matters into his own hands but Dack escaped.

citation.text: "Malfegor", section "On Grixis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas persuades Malfegor to serve as his second-in-command on Alara.
timeline.quote: persuaded him to serve as the planeswalker's second-in-command on Alara

citation.text: "Malfegor", section "In league with Bolas". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Malfegor leads troops across Esper wiping out nearly every sphinx except Sharuum, then assaults Bant.
timeline.quote: wiping out nearly every sphinx except Sharuum

citation.text: "Malfegor", section "In league with Bolas". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Malfegor is killed during the siege of Bant by Rafiq and Elspeth Tirel.
timeline.quote: Malfegor was killed by the combined forces of Rafiq and Elspeth Tirel .

citation.text: "Malfegor", section "In league with Bolas". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rafiq returns to Bant with Etherium and the rescued pair in time to warn of Malfegor's invasion.
timeline.quote: just in time to warn Bant of Malfegor 's invasion force

citation.text: "Rafiq", section "The Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth Tirel gives Rafiq the Sword of Asha and wings of light, and he slays Malfegor.
timeline.quote: Elspeth Tirel threw Rafiq the legendary Sword of Asha

citation.text: "Rafiq", section "The Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Conflux many Esper leaders were slain; Sharuum fled and secluded herself.
timeline.quote: she fled and secluded herself to prepare more stringent defenses

citation.text: "Sharuum", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sifa ascends as a planeswalker when the demon Malfegor tries to steal her spark.
timeline.quote: Sifa ascended when the demon Malfegor tried to steal Sifa's spark

citation.text: "Sifa Grent", section "Grixis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
